text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout finished: inference-api v3.11.0 -> prod-us-west (canary 5%). Kicking off post-deploy synths: prefill, kv-warmup, stream-echo. run=sniff-3123456789
amir: quick glance: synth shows a ~1.2% increase in streaming 429s starting ~50s after canary. not huge but notable.
kate: any 5xxs? 429s could be rate limiting on an internal throttler.
sasha: logs show throttled connections from gw-7 to svc-08: ```[sniff] 00:52 stream 429 gw-7 -> svc-08 reason=conn-throttle pool=worker-fast```
nisha: that host (svc-08) had a recent kernel upgrade last week, might have lower conn backlog default. ops-bot can we cross-check host metrics?
ops-bot: hostcheck: svc-08 conn_backlog=128 (baseline 512), accept_queue=spike to 90% at 00:51. No 5xxs reported.
amir: sounds like degraded accept backlog causing spurious 429s on tail streams. traffic % for canary on svc-08 is ~22% of its capacity due to placement.
kate: mitigation options: 1) pin prod-us-west to v3.10.x 2) evict canary pods from svc-08 3) quick patch to increase kernel backlog via daemonset and re-run synth.
sasha: prefer patch over rollback if low blast. we can push kernel param change via privileged daemonset but that needs canary gating and a quick post-deploy check.
nisha: alternative: shift canary traffic away from svc-08 by adjusting scheduler weights for 10m. less intrusive.
amir: risk assessment: user-facing error rate increase small but affects streaming UX. I'd prefer to avoid full rollback. propose hold rollout and shift canary off svc-08 while we apply ephemeral kernel tune on affected hosts.
ops-bot: prepared command: `rdctl scheduler-weight --service inference-api --region prod-us-west --exclude-host svc-08 --duration 10m --reason "synth-429-tail"`
kate: execute weight-shift, hold on further rollout, then run a short focused sniffer targeting stream endpoints.
deploy-bot: Weight shift initiated by kate. Status: canary traffic rebalanced over 60s.
amir: running focused sniffer run against stream endpoints now. early results: 429s dropped to baseline within 2m. p95 latency unchanged.
sasha: good. I'll prepare daemonset with `net.core.somaxconn=512` and `net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=512` and mark it as rollout-gated.
nisha: please also add a host-check to preflight that asserts accept_queue >= 400 for next release. we should fail CI if nodes show lower defaults.
kate: agreed. create RD-3377 for follow-ups and release-note blurb.
ops-bot: hold maintained. canary paused at 5%. Once daemonset applied and verified we'll resume gradual rollout.
amir: note for postmortem: scheduler heuristics placed disproportionate canary load on svc-08 due to recent capacity rebalancing. add to infra tuning backlog.
sasha: applying daemonset now to affected hosts. will post results in RD-3377.
ops-bot: Daemonset applied. Host metrics show somaxconn updated. Focused sniffer run shows no spike in 429s.
deploy-bot: Hold lifted. Resuming canary progression to 20% over 10m. Monitoring enabled.
